q: When was the project started, and by whom?
When was the offline shop introduced, and who built it?
How did the battle pass evolve?
When did work on Luna start?
facts: Luna work started in February 2024 ('wip: luna')

q: What is CCC and when was it started?
facts: a management / administration platform for the game
a first CCC existed from September 2021 (Luscha)
in January 2025 the old CCC was removed and replaced

q: When was the world boss implemented?
When was the skill tree introduced?
facts: server side and launcher side implemented together

q: When was the queue and lobby system implemented?
facts: an adaptive queue and lobby system

q: When was the Wiki Manager created?
facts: it replaced/revamped the older wiki builder

q: What is the avatar system and when did it appear?
facts: tied to the arena draft (building a character: race, skill group, bonuses)

q: When were the big hunt (mhunt / caccia grossa) maps added?
facts: big hunt (caccia grossa) content existed since early 2019
new big hunt maps were added in November 2024 by XanderOW

q: Where does the deployer live and how did it change?
facts: firewall moved to nftables in August 2025

q: When were the three-way war and the castle event removed?
When did the renderer get a DirectX 11 backend?
facts: an RHI rendering layer was introduced in December 2025
DirectX 11 support arrived in late December 2025

q: What is the Forge System built on?
facts: it is built on Luna (the Lua scripting system)

q: When was multiplayer VR support added?
facts: there is no VR support in the project
